01 / the reel

This is a film, and you are running it

Scroll on to move it forward. Scroll back and it runs backwards. Every frame was shot, cut and graded by me.

02 / how I work

Scripts and scenes, then the camera

As PR and social lead for Job Fair 2026 I wrote the scripts, staged the scenes, shot them and cut them together. Four ads, the opening film, and a campaign that reached television three times.

03 / the bands

Music is where most of it starts

Promos and teasers for the bands I grew up around in Skopje. Golemata Voda, Perseida, Marigold. The film you are scrolling is the Perseida spot.

04 / the kit

One body, two primes, whatever light there is

A Fujifilm X-T2 and the hour I am given. Golden hour, handheld, no lighting truck and no second take.
